newsitem.title: GREECE: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) RAISES GASOLINE PRICES.
newsitem.headline: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) RAISES GASOLINE PRICES.

text.p: Greece's Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) will raise gasoline prices by 0.40 drachmas per litre, effective on Thursday.
Heating fuel prices will be lowered by 0.80 drachmas and transport diesel by 1.0 drachmas per litre, it said.
The price adjustments come after lower world gasoline and diesel prices, down by $1.8 and $7.1 per metric tonne and a firmer dollar/drachma exchange rate, up by 4.16 drachmas per $, DEP said.
